title_tr: Sessiz saatlerde e-posta gönderilmeye devam ediyor
issue: Users who configure quiet hours still receive emails during those hours, and receive none outside them. For example quiet hours 8-10 should block emails at 9:00 and allow them at 11:00.

ground_truth.root_cause: PreferenceStore.set_quiet_hours stores the tuple as (end, start); in_quiet_hours then treats the window as wrapping past midnight and inverts it.
